name: Simple Form – Ultimate Form Builder with Quiz, Poll, Multi Step Forms, Conditional Logic, Form Analytics & Advanced Integrations
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
Simple Form is the most comprehensive WordPress form builder plugin that goes beyond traditional contact forms. Build beautiful forms, interactive quizzes, engaging polls, custom login/registration forms, and comment forms – all with a powerful drag-and-drop interface. No coding required!

🎯 Why Simple Form is the Best WordPress Form Plugin

Simple Form isn’t just another form builder – it’s a complete form solution that includes:

✅ Contact Forms – Create unlimited contact forms with advanced features
✅ Quiz Builder – Build interactive quizzes to engage audiences and capture leads
✅ Poll Creator – Create polls to gather opinions and feedback
✅ Login & Registration Forms – Replace default WordPress login/signup forms
✅ Comment Forms – Customize WordPress comment forms
✅ Multi-Step Forms – Break long forms into easy steps with progress indicators
✅ Conditional Logic – Show/hide fields based on user input
✅ Form Analytics – Track performance, conversions, and user behavior
✅ Advanced Integrations – Connect with Mailchimp, Google Sheets, Trello, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack
✅ Lead Management – Powerful filtering, export, and tracking capabilities
✅ Custom Themes – 7+ pre-built themes plus unlimited custom themes
✅ Floating Forms – Position forms anywhere (inline, bottom-right, bottom-left)
✅ GDPR Compliant – Built-in consent checkboxes and privacy features

🎯 Quiz Builder (NEW!)

Create interactive quizzes to boost engagement and capture leads:

Quiz Features
– Unlimited quizzes and questions
– Multiple choice questions with images
– Set correct answers and passing scores
– Show/hide results and correct answers
– Randomize questions and answers
– Time limits for quizzes
– Collect user information (name, email)
– Quiz analytics and results tracking
– Reward system (coupons, redirects)
– Custom quiz themes
– Shortcode: [simple_quiz id="1"]

Perfect For:
– Educational websites
– Training and certification
– Lead generation
– Customer engagement
– Product knowledge tests
– Fun personality quizzes

📊 Poll Creator (NEW!)

Gather opinions and feedback with beautiful polls:

Poll Features
– Unlimited polls and answers
– Single or multiple choice polls
– Featured images for polls
– Answer images support
– Show results (always, after vote, never)
– Allow/prevent revoting
– Require login to vote
– Set closing dates
– Display results as percentage, count, or both
– Real-time results tracking
– Poll analytics dashboard
– Shortcode: [simple_poll id="1"]

Use Cases:
– Customer feedback
– Market research
– Community engagement
– Product preferences
– Event planning
– Opinion surveys

Replace default WordPress forms with custom-designed alternatives:

WordPress Login Form

– Social login integration ready

How to Use

After activating the plugin navigate to your Admin Dashboard > SimpleForm > Form and from there build your required form using drag and drop. Next save it with any form name.
You will then automatically be redirected to the “Data” page, from there you can edit your form or create a form on any of your pages or posts using the shortcode.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Simple Form”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
sections.faq:
Is Simple Form really free?

A: Yes! Simple Form offers powerful features completely free, including form builder, quiz builder, poll creator, analytics, integrations, and more. We also have a Pro version with additional advanced features.

Do I need coding knowledge to use Simple Form?

A: No! Simple Form features an intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Anyone can create professional forms, quizzes, and polls without writing a single line of code.

What types of forms can I create?

A: You can create any type of form including contact forms, registration forms, survey forms, order forms, feedback forms, quote request forms, and more.

Can I create multi-step forms?

A: Yes! Add page breaks to your form and enable progress indicators to create beautiful multi-step forms with visual progress tracking.

Can I add conditional logic to my forms?

A: Absolutely! Enable conditional logic on any field to show/hide fields or change values based on user input.

How do I create a quiz?

A: Navigate to Quizzes in the Simple Form menu, click “Create Quiz,” add your questions and answers, mark correct answers, configure settings, and save. Use the shortcode [simple_quiz id="X"] to display it.

Can I add images to quiz questions?

A: Yes! You can add images to both questions and answer options for more engaging quizzes.

How do polls work?

A: Create a poll with multiple answer options, configure settings (single/multiple choice, show results, etc.), and embed using [simple_poll id="X"]. Users vote and can see results based on your settings.

Can I limit quiz time?

A: Yes! Set a time limit in quiz settings to create timed quizzes.

Which integrations are available?

A: Simple Form integrates with Mailchimp, Google Sheets, Trello, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and email notifications.

How do I connect to Mailchimp?

A: Go to Integrations > Mailchimp, enter your API key, select your list, map form fields, and save. Form submissions will automatically sync to Mailchimp.

Can I send form data to Google Sheets?

A: Yes! Connect your Google account in Integrations > Google Sheets, select your spreadsheet, and map form fields to columns.

Does WhatsApp integration work on mobile?

A: Yes! The WhatsApp integration works seamlessly on both desktop and mobile devices.

Can I replace the WordPress login form?

A: Yes! Go to Settings > Auth Settings, create a custom login form, and enable “Replace WordPress Login Form.”

Will replacing forms break my site?

A: No! Simple Form safely replaces forms while maintaining all WordPress functionality. You can disable replacements anytime.

Can I customize WooCommerce forms?

A: Yes! Create custom WooCommerce login and registration forms in Auth Settings.

What analytics are tracked?

A: Simple Form tracks views, submissions, success rate, conversion rate, errors, and redirects for each form.

Can I export form submissions?

A: Yes! Export leads in CSV, JSON, or PDF format, or print them directly from the Leads page.

How do I filter leads by date?

A: Use the date filter on the Leads page to view submissions from today, yesterday, last week, last month, or a custom date range.

What is the notification ball?

A: The notification ball appears when new forms are submitted, allowing you to quickly view and manage new leads.

What Makes Simple Form Unique

  1. All-in-One Solution – Forms, quizzes, polls, login forms, and more in one plugin
  2. Generous Free Version – Advanced features that others charge for
  3. Modern Interface – Beautiful, intuitive design that’s easy to use
  4. Performance Optimized – Fast loading, clean code, efficient database queries
  5. Regular Updates – Constantly improving with new features and fixes
  6. Excellent Support – Responsive support team ready to help
  7. Active Development – New features added regularly based on user feedback
